title: Project registration cancellation - the consequences for ongoing buyers
p1:
A project can be cancelled even after buyers have already invested their money. But what happens to the people who trusted the project and are waiting for their homes?

Many buyers assume that cancellation of registration means their rights disappear overnight. That is not always true.
p2: The surprising part is that project registration cancellation does not simply erase every responsibility of the developer. Existing buyers may still have claims and protections depending on the reason for cancellation, the stage of the project, and the applicable legal process.
p3:
For buyers, the key lesson is to not panic or rely only on verbal promises. Keep records of agreements, payments, and communications. A cancelled registration can create complications, but it can also trigger remedies and accountability for those affected.

Before investing in any project, checking its registration status and understanding possible risks can save years of stress.
conclusion: If a project registration is cancelled after buyers have paid, what protection do you think buyers should receive first: refund, completion of the project, or stronger legal action?
